original_test_intent: Read and validate SEL version, entry count, free space, overflow and supported-operation metadata without changing the log.
original_method: Issue Storage 0x0a/0x40 locally and decode the complete response.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the versioned SEL Info schema and optional baseline policy once; routine bounded reads need no per-run approval.
safety_requirements: Never clear, reserve, erase, add or delete SEL entries
agent_execution_scope: Check internal capacity consistency and optional baseline

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level read is related, but unsafe transport and lack of raw/schema validation make it insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x0a/0x40 or an equivalent pinned parser, recording exact completion and field semantics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw command, script and timing are retained as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate response length, decode version/count/free-space/overflow/operation support, check capacity consistency and freshness, and preserve non-mutation evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes destructive generic clearing and adds deterministic allocation/status acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This reports SEL metadata only; it does not validate individual entries, allocation reservation or clear behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong unit or overflow interpretation can hide lost fault history.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor read can be a project override only if it exposes equivalent metadata, freshness and error semantics; raw-IPMI tool coverage remains unverified if skipped.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master's clear-logs precondition would destroy the SEL state being measured, and transport-only Criteria plus DeepSeek's subjective output do not validate allocation/status semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and intent are explicit; target schema and baseline values are execution readiness inputs rather than an irresolvable contradiction.

review_improvement: Turns a destructive, transport-only check into a complete read-only SEL health/capacity validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get SEL Info has a finite response whose length, version, capacity and overflow fields can be deterministically parsed without mutation, so it is FULLY AUTOMATABLE once the firmware schema is pinned.
